title: Systematic Mispricing of Speculative Stocks and the Cross-Sectional Risk-Return Trade-off
authors: Justin Birru; Hannes Mohrschladt; Trevor Young
eligible_reason: Cross-sectional asset pricing (portfolio sorts, factor regressions, GMM, Fama-MacBeth) on speculative stocks; no policy shock, no DiD or event-study design.
design_notes: MatlabCode.m builds monthly stock-level dataset and factor time series; tables from portfolio and time-series regressions with Newey-West t-stats (tstatNW.m) and GMM (gmmestimation.m). Regression inventory empty (MATLAB).
data_files_note: README: public factor data shipped; WRDS files (CRSP, COMPUSTAT, IBES) and the Corwin CSID-PERMNO map ship only the header row (CRSP.csv 80 bytes, COMPUSTAT.csv 341 bytes).
data_provenance_note: Stock-level WRDS data not shipped (header rows only).
screener_notes: Published PDF read (papers/mnsc/mnsc.2024.08815.pdf via data/text); no DiD/event-study/fixed-effects terms appear in the text.
